notes.title: Nova Drift Collab Arrives!
notes.content:
A new collab deck is here, this time featuring the fantastic space shooter Nova Drift!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858210/Nova_Drift/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/06f5c65aa5416efe0cff517f5653b5c35a195448.jpg[/img]
Many familiar ships and mods take on a new form, reimagined as Quantum Protocol cards. Play mods to mix and match effects onto your ships and discover new combinations every run! Will you go all in with damage? Or balance defensive mods with offensive power? Or maybe focus on setting up the field to drop the almighty Leviathan!!! The choice is yours.

The card art is by none other than the dev of Nova Drift themselves! Chimeric!

But there's more!

Also included in this update is a complete rework of the Spirit archetype!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/39fc579964f5ddde3eb790b12b7ba404d84afe97.jpg[/img]
The Spirit cards have historically been a niche and awkward deck, centered around a strange rhythm of returning cards to your hand. With the rework, they still return to your hand, but they now make use of a much more intuitive mechanic of linking together on the field. There's far too much to explain here, give the deck a try!

[u]Cards[/u]

[b]Changed [/b]Cockatrice.myth. New summon condition.
[b]Changed [/b]Mermaid.myth. New summon condition and effect.

Mermaid and Cockatrice have been changed to reward the most unique part of the character that uses them: combining lots of different cards into one deck.

[b]Buffed [/b]Octavia.mage. MANUAL effect is now instant.
[b]Buffed [/b]Ignis.sorc. Now deals more damage based on a multiplier rather than flat amount.
[b]Buffed [/b]Tempus.sorc. Base form is 1 + X, upgrade is 2 x X.

[b]Nerfed [/b]Spear.blood. Level 1 -> 2. Rarity white -> blue.
[b]Nerfed [/b]Spear.blood+. Damage 4 -> 3

[u]Level[/u]

Reduced the number of bananas in Esper's introduction deck.
Removed a few enemies from Queen's introduction chess level.

Special thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/Nigokos1]Nigokos[/url] for the art of Aurora.

Also come say hi in the Discord! This decks can get tricky, but the Discord is a great place to get help!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/quantumprotocol][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/2aad81291eb17a9180405209526a6e8eb064395f.jpg[/img][/url]

This update has been in the works for a long long while, thank you all for playing! Please consider leaving a review if you haven't already, it really helps me continue working on this game and other games in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/7cb773aa2a338806cbdc248315de13b3d820e2e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Vault of the Void Collab Arrives!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/fa467a017299af313fba8d913de70bf2e6a3ecef.png[/img]

A new collab is here! This time for the card game Vault of the Void! 

Take on dungeons with a brand new playstyle! The deck is fast and aggressive, making use of a super cool combo system inspired by The Hidden from Vault of the Void. The deck is fairly easy to pilot, so give it a try! You can find it on the far right side of the level select, grouped with the other collab decks.

As of this update, Vault of the Void is still in Early Access, but having played it a bunch, I can assure you it is well worth playing today and there's plenty of "game" in the game to justify picking it up :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1135810?utm_source=collab&utm_campaign=qp

Oh, and Mahou has their red card now, you'll have to beat a new boss after Ascension 4 to get it though. So for all you late-game players out there, there's new stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/09cadf90f01f73dcb263b8056767ba3725de3824.png[/img]

Now for the regular patch notes:

[b]NEW [/b] Collab deck for Vault of the Void
[b]NEW [/b] Mahou red card.
[b]NEW [/b] Boss level after Ascension 4

[u]Cards[/u]

Improved keyword descriptions of VOID and CONDITION.

[b]NERFED [/b]Kazane, can no longer target itself.
[b]FIXED [/b] typos on mahou cards.
[b]ADJUST [/b] rarity of Potentia and Lux. Potentia is now green, Lux is now blue.

[u]Enemy[/u]

[b]NERFED [/b]Guillotine. Only triggers on player effects now.
[b]NERFED [/b]Zirus. The arms attack slower.
[b]FIXED [/b]bug with Venom not doing quite what it said on the text.

[u]Game[/u]

Ascensions are now shorter. The last sector specifically is much shorter.

Thanks for playing! And please consider leaving a review, it really helps a lot! <3

Be sure to check out the Discord if you have any questions or just want to say hi :D
[url=https://discord.com/invite/quantumprotocol][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/2aad81291eb17a9180405209526a6e8eb064395f.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: March Update
notes.content:
Some quality of life changes and an update to the spirit deck!

[u]Cards[/u]

Major update to spirit cards! The basic cards are the same, the higher rarity cards have all been adjusted to be more flexible. The changes are kinda long...but check them out in-game, the deck should feel noticeably nicer to play and generally more powerful as a result.

[b]Nerfed [/b]Gunner.eden Now needs to deal damage multiple times to lower turn draw countdown.
[b]Adjusted [/b]level of Ragnarok, Crossfire, and BowSnipe. They are now the level you think they should be.

[u]Enemies[/u]

Dark bosses generally buffed.

All Dark bosses act 1 turn faster. (The previous change to wave threat meant all enemies act 1 turn slower, this change will make dark bosses more interactive, since many dark bosses rely on layering their actions quickly).

Remi 45hp -> 55hp
Griffin now starts with an extra minion card.
Lorado 80hp -> 95hp
Persephone attack 1 -> 2
Demeter 55hp -> 65hp
Demeter thorn enemies now have more health, but Demeter's counters are reduced from 5 -> 3
Kobo 50hp -> 55hp. Now starts with a lantern instead of a katana.
Decima spawns with extra minions.

[u]Game[/u]

[b]Fixed [/b]issue where upgrading multiple cards could result in health going below 0.

[b]Reduced [/b]wave threat penalty, 50% -> 25% health

Dealing 0 damage will now prevent wave threat from increasing.
Minimum enemy action time is now 2 (up from 1)

Can now view the board when game over.
Can skip death animation by clicking.
Can now close level select panel by pressing ESC.
Pausing now disabled while game is resolving actions. Quitting the game at bad times was resulting in crashes.

Options for VSync and FPS limit.

notes.title: Eden Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JsTEWYHpVOw;full][/previewyoutube]

The One Step from Eden collab is here! A brand new deck arrives with iconic characters and some strangely familiar game mechanics. This is one of the fastest and most fluid decks to date (just like the game they're from)! Try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/c1cd8a573dea1cda616d2ab7e557d616d1e05c46.png[/img]

Also! Queen is now in One Step from Eden! Check her out, she looks super cool!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/0035369bcbf7cd5a4d21729b869a903c1771bc4d.gif[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/960690/One_Step_From_Eden/

There's also a bunch of other regular updates!

[b]Big Change: Wave Alert[/b]
Wave Alert is now Wave Threat. 
[olist]
[*] Wave Threat increases every turn, and is decreased by dealing damage to enemies.
[*] If Wave Threat reaches max, you lose half your health.
[*] Enemies act faster at higher Wave Threat levels.
[/olist]
[i]Stalling is very optimal but not that interesting to play. This upgrade to the Wave Alert system will force players to deal damage at a steady rate throughout the level. Hopefully the new system is not too punishing for players who are already struggling, but if it is, the difficulty settings are more accessible now.[/i]

[u]Game[/u]

[b]New [/b]art gallery and unlockable art.
[b]New [/b]difficulty options on operator select.
[b]Removed [/b]turn handicap options (replaced by operator select difficulty options)

[b]Fixed [/b]passives will now properly pulse when their effect is triggered.

[b]Added [/b]error effect when trying to play a card with a condition that has not been met.

[b]Changed [/b]loot capacity for green and blue loot increased by 1.

[b]Nerfed [/b]number of rerolls in ascensions for secondary archetypes reduced 2 -> 1 (primary rerolls unchanged)
[b]Nerfed [/b]Dragoon's Comet stage, it is now shorter and has more loot caches.

[u]Cards[/u]

[b]Added [/b]new card. Afterburner!
[b]Added [/b]icons for physical and magic damage.

[b]Removed [/b]healing effects from enemy cards (to work better with Wave Threat)
[b]Nerfed [/b]Zirus boss. Arm health reduced. Spike attack reduced.

[b]Changed [/b]Tanzaku.spirit now force activates the leftmost manual effects on cards.
[b]Fixed [/b]Tanzaku.spirt bug where ONCE effects were not properly being activated when multiple Tanzakus were on the field.

[u]Localization[/u]

[b]Added [/b]support for Korean characters
[b]Added [/b]card effect flags to localization files.

Was super fun working on this collab! One Step from Eden is such a fun game (even if I'm pretty bad at it), was really happy when the dev ok'd all of this! Also! Queen looks super awesome in One Step from Eden, and the Eden cards in Quantum ended up really unique and interesting. It was cool to see how well the characters translated to Quantum. I hope you all enjoy the new deck! And as always, feel free to leave any feedback in the game's Discord, I'm not scary I promise UwU 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/quantumprotocol][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/2aad81291eb17a9180405209526a6e8eb064395f.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lunar New Year Update
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year!

This update brings a major system change as well as some other quality of life and presentation changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/5f37065fea45f08d059b688551b224b313b39e8e.png[/img]
[b]NEW[/b] Wave Alert

This replaces the old turn counter time limit.
If you have more cards than the enemy, enemies will attack faster. If you have fewer cards than enemies, enemies will attack slower.
The base action time of enemies has been increased from 6 -> 7

What does all this mean? It means if you play normally the game will be almost exactly the same as before. But the game is a bit more forgiving if you fall behind and gives you more ways to make a comeback. 
Additionally, it smooths out some issues where waves are the hardest when they first spawn and become trivial when there is one enemy left. With Wave Alert, waves act slower when they first spawn (since there are so many cards) then start acting faster as the number of cards goes down.

If you have any feedback. Let me know in the game's Discord! (linked at the end)

[u]Game[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/02d46fc6817a555df7123ed5b32c072409516a9d.png[/img]
[b]NEW[/b] layout for the card collection!

[b]NEW[/b] layout of level end reports, now shows storage.

[u]Cards[/u]

[b]BUFFED[/b] Tanzaku.spirit. Trigger is no longer UNIQUE.
[b]ADJUSTED[/b] Potentia.sorc. Buff amount increased from X -> 1 + X, but the buff now decays every turn.
[b]ADJUSTED[/b] Yamata.spirit. Attack buff multiplier increased from 0.5 -> 1, but the buff now only lasts for one attack.

Also, check out this super cool illustration of Queen!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/b26f32ec2bc70faa8f8c68d86660b8e9ae8e107a.jpg[/img]

If you have any feedback, or want to learn about the crazy card combos that often inspire these updates, check out the game's Discord! <3
[url=https://discord.com/invite/quantumprotocol][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/2aad81291eb17a9180405209526a6e8eb064395f.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Mage Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BCdyrkWqNyo;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/eefa007e3a1df42e6f6cd919a7d377f414bcb830.png[/img]

Mage deck has arrived! Command powerful spells that gain strength when manipulated by the master mages.

Also included are a bunch of regular changes and fixes.

[u]Game[/u]
Waystones now force a Reprogram.
[i]Overpreparing for bosses was optimal, but not always interesting. This change should limit the amount of preparation time for bosses as well as help players who fall behind in the waves leading up to the boss.[/i]

Error messages will now pop up if you try to click cards that cannot attack.
[i]A teaching tool I've wanted to do for a while. This should help new players learn why their cards are not attacking when they click them.[/i]

Fixed an issue where deck codes would not work when retrying a level.

Added more music variations to Ascensions.

Moved tutorial text to external text files.
[i]This is an ongoing thing to make localization easier in the future.[/i]

[u]Cards[/u]
[b]BUFFED[/b] Saigo+. Health 4 -> 5
[b]FIXED[/b] issue where ONCE effects were not triggering when added via Pollination.
[b]ADJUSTED[/b] Cache enemies. BitCache now gives fixed rarities, while CryptCaches give more loot.
[b]FIXED[/b] issue where Pomegranate would not respect ONCE flags.

[b]ADJUSTED[/b] the "fire" effect on red cards so it is more transparent.

[u]Enemy[/u]
[b]BUFFED[/b] Tsukuyomi boss. It now adds counters when you turn draw.

As always, thanks for playing! 
Consider leaving a like, or checking out the game's Discord: https://discord.com/invite/quantumprotocol
So much of every update is to address feedback I read in the Discord :)

Oh, I'll leave you with this amazing illustration of Ria and her best friend. Not a robot!

notes.title: Mid Patch Update
notes.content:
Smaller update with several fixes to bugs and card interactions.

[u]Interactions[/u]

[b]Zombie + Trance[/b]. Zombies will not attack immediately when they revive when Trance is destroyed.
[b]King vs Guillotine[/b]. King's gameover effect is now a passive (was a trigger), so it activates immediately and no longer causes weird visual bugs with Guillotine.
[b]DamageCapacitor vs Guillotine[/b]. ONCE effects are now treated as UNIQUE effects, so capacitor will no longer loop vs Guillotine.

[u]Cards[/u]

[b]Reworked[/b] Plunge+. No longer instant, instead, you can add it from trash to hand ONCE.
[b]Fixed[/b] Treasure+. It now properly draws more cards.
[b]Nerfed[/b] Tsukuyomi.spirit. HP 8 -> 4

[u]Enemies[/u]

[b]Reworked[/b] Venom. It now moves to the top of your deck and no longer deals damage when drawn.

[u]Bugs[/u]

[b]Fixed[/b] minions spawning in player's trash if a boss was killed before the minions by an AOE effect.
[b]Fixed[/b] some cases where leaving a level during ascension route selection could cause issues.



Working on a new deck for the next update, so look forward to that! Wonder who it'll be for...

Thanks for playing!
If you're enjoying the game, consider leaving a review or joining the Discord (https://discord.com/invite/quantumprotocol) :D

notes.title: New Character: OMEGA
notes.content:
The leader of the Astrika Foundation himself. Now playable.

OMEGA's deck uses the new Legion cards, a set of programs based on militarized vampires. Absorb the power of enemies and cast powerful blood arts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/96ed19b862adc6acf8e1c3b0dbf54a4e2b26b174.png[/img]

There are quite a few cards, but they can generally be separated into a few groups with very similar effects.

[h2]Group 1: Soldiers[/h2]
All the soldier cards share 2 out of 3 effects. The only difference is their middle effects. One is draw power, one is a tank, and one is for AOE.

[h3]Li.legion[/h3]
1/2
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Deal 1 damage to the card one slot ahead of this card.
[b]TRIGGER[/b] - When this card takes damage (and is on the field at the end of the turn), draw 1 card.
[b]PASSIVE[/b] - When this card deals physical damage, heal it 1 health and increase its attack by 1 (MAX +3). If this card takes damage, reduce its attack by 1.

[h3]Ora.legion[/h3]
1/2
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Deal 1 damage to the card one slot ahead of this card.
[b]DEFENSE[/b] - This card cannot take more than 1 damage at once.
[b]PASSIVE[/b] - When this card deals physical damage, heal it 1 health and increase its attack by 1 (MAX +3). If this card takes damage, reduce its attack by 1.

[h3]Xelia.legion[/h3]
1/2
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Deal 1 damage to the card one slot ahead of this card.
[b]TRIGGER[/b] - When this card takes damage (and is on the field at the end of the turn), deal 1 magic damage to all exposed enemy cards.
[b]PASSIVE[/b] - When this card deals physical damage, heal it 1 health and increase its attack by 1 (MAX +3). If this card takes damage, reduce its attack by 1.

[h2]Group 2: Lieutenants[/h2]
These two cards are almost the same card, the only difference is the type of cards they search. Once again, only the middle effect is different.

[h3]Yiko.legion[/h3]
2/4
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Deal 1 damage to the cards directly above, below, left, and right of this card.
[b]MANUAL[/b] - Add X level 1 or lower .legion cards from deck to hand, where X is half this card's attack power rounded down. Then remove all stat modifiers from this card.
[b]PASSIVE[/b] - When this card deals physical damage, heal it 1 health and increase its attack by 1 (MAX +4). If this card takes damage, reduce its attack by 1.

[h3]Misera.legion[/h3]
2/4
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Deal 1 damage to the cards directly above, below, left, and right of this card.
[b]MANUAL[/b] - Add X level 1 or lower .blood cards from deck to hand, where X is half this card's attack power rounded down. Then remove all stat modifiers from this card.
[b]PASSIVE[/b] - When this card deals physical damage, heal it 1 health and increase its attack by 1 (MAX +4). If this card takes damage, reduce its attack by 1.

[h2]Group 3: Generals[/h2]
These are the boss cards. One of them you will need to unlock deep in the Ascension Trials! Oh! And take a close look at Syka, her first effect can place the card "anywhere", that means she can place cards on the enemy's side of the field!!! Why is that useful? Dunno, play around ;)

[h3]Syka.legion[/h3]
2/4
[b]MANUAL[/b] - Select a .blood card in your trash, VOID it, then play a 1|1 minion anywhere on the field. Afterwards, reactivate this card.
[b]MANUAL[/b] - Attack with all cards on your field with 1 health.
[b]CONDITION[/b] - You must have exactly 3 .blood cards in your trash.

[h3]???.legion[/h3]
?/?
???
???
???


[h2]Group 4: Blood Weapons[/h2]
These are the main support cards to help you deal damage and block damage.

[h3]Spear.blood[/h3]
0/1
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Deal 1 damage to all cards ahead of this card (including your own). If only one card would be hit, deal 2 damage to it instead.
[b]TRIGGER[/b] - If this card destroys a card, return it to your hand.
[b]QUICK[/b] - Playing this card does not take a turn.

[h3]Sword.blood[/h3]
1/1
[b]TRIGGER[/b] - If one of your cards in the same column as this card attacks (except Sword.blood), attack with this card.
[b]PASSIVE[/b] - If one of your other cards is in the same column as this card, any damage this card deals is treated as damage from that other card.
[b]QUICK[/b] - Playing this card does not take a turn.

[h3]Shield.blood[/h3]
0/2
[b]DEFENSE[/b] - This card cannot take more than 1 damage at once.
[b]PASSIVE[/b] - Cards that damage this card take 1 damage back.
[b]QUICK[/b] - Playing this card does not take a turn.

[h2]Group 5: Recursion Spells[/h2]
Get your cards to the field faster and set up your plays.

[h3]Revival.blood[/h3]
0/1
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Select a level 1 or lower .legion card in your trash, play it to the field.
[b]QUICK[/b] - Playing this card does not take a turn.

[h3]Orb.blood[/h3]
0/1
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Play one level 1 or lower .legion card from your hand to the field.
[b]DESTRUCTION[/b] - Draw a card.
[b]QUICK[/b] - Playing this card does not take a turn.

[h3]Origin.blood[/h3]
0/1
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Select X level 1 or lower .blood cards (except Origin.blood) in your trash. Where X is the number of cards on your field with 1 health. Add the selected card(s) to your hand, then DECOMPILE all cards on your field with 1 health.
[b]QUICK[/b] - Playing this card does not take a turn.

[h2]Group 6: Big Plays[/h2]
Hyper.blood is like a budget Queen from Queen's chess deck, and you probably already know how good that card is. Plunge.blood is a super fun card with questionable practicality at times. But going for big multikill chains is super fun and satisfying.

[h3]Hyper.blood[/h3]
0/1
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Deal magic damage to all enemy cards equal to the number of cards you control (MAX 3), then deal 1 damage to all cards you control.

[h3]Plunge.blood[/h3]
0/1
[b]INITIALIZE[/b] - Select a card on the field with 1 health (except Plunge.blood), destroy it, then deal 1 damage to all cards on the same side of the field as the destroyed card. Then return this card to your hand.
[b]TRIGGER[/b] - If this card is in your hand after a turn, discard this card.

Mostly systems changes in this patch. Fixing some general jank. Also smoothing out some difficulty spikes. 

The puzzles in this game are not meant to be roadblocks. They are meant to show specific card interactions and help you think about the game in new ways. Ways that are hopefully useful in the main Dungeon levels.

notes.title: Beta Update 10-25-2020
notes.content:
The game's dialogue scenes are kinda hard to get into. They're more like reading a book than playing a game. And while the Visual Novel format is not going away, I've gotten a lot of feedback that the scenes are really boring, with many suggestions including adding music.

The scenes did not have music originally to save on development time, but I have since found the time to revisit the scenes and update many of them with a set of new background music themes. They really do go a long way to making the scenes more interesting!

notes.title: Beta Update 10-7-2020
notes.content:
TL;DR: Get into game faster. Deck Diversity. Asynchronous Multiplayer.

[h2]Get into game faster.[/h2]

The intro sequence has been removed. Getting people into the gameplay as quickly as possible is really important. When you buy a card game, you want to play cards. The story stuff has been more subtly added to the rest of the game, which will almost certainly make things harder to understand, but hopefully the characters are still fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/598d4cf954c06b2012b8cf9dbb0cc497a5210ee9.png[/img]
[h2]Deck Diversity.[/h2]

Brand new "Algorithm" cards. These are super special cards you can find in the Ascension Trials. They provide a unique effect when in your Storage! (think of them like relics/artifacts/passives in roguelikes). But you can also put them in your deck for a different effect. And when in your deck you will ALWAYS draw them in your opening hand.

The idea here was to make Ascension runs feel more unique. Algorithm cards should instantly make you think about your deck differently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905959/77e70d122ef1fa5d128d506c12a014cdd7e89e54.png[/img]
[h2]Asynchronous Multiplayer.[/h2]

Clearing an Ascension Trial will now create a "deck code" for the deck you used to win with. Players can use these codes on any dungeon/ascension level to start with the same deck. So basically you can let other people use the decks you've won with.

The key thing here is you can only CREATE new decks in the ascension levels,  but you can USE a deck code on any dungeon. So if you're having trouble on a particular level, ask for help in the game's Discord server! Someone might have a super OP deck you can try out.

[h2]Ascension Rework.[/h2]

Ascension Trials were getting WAY too long. Potentially several hours to finish a full run. The trials are now broken up into sets of 3 bosses. So when you clear a set, you'll be bumped up to the next set when you do another run. Right now, once you clear an ascension level, there is no way to "go back" to a previous one. This may change in the future.
